Download latest WinSCP 6.7

Published:2026-10-14

WinSCP 6.7 is a major application update. New features and enhancements include:

  • Synchronization of two local directories.
  • Support for OpenSSH ssh-agent.
  • Improvements to working with sessions and workspaces.
  • Improved dark theme support.
  • Experimental 64-bit version.
  • List of all changes.
